$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Written from scratch for OneMind (issue #855); no Meshtastic code or tables.
title: OneMind message (onemind.message/v1)
description: One LoRa message as the gateway stores and serves it (/v1/messages, #856). The text lives only in the gateway database and in signed-job replies on the loopback job API; it never rides NATS (events carry ids only, onemind.message.event.schema.json). Transport lora-mc is MeshCore; lora-mt is reserved for the 1.1 Meshtastic bridge (#739) and refused in 1.0. text maxLength is MeshCore MAX_TEXT_LEN (160, src/helpers/BaseChatMesh.h) in characters; the send guard also caps the UTF-8 bytes (sdk/contracts/meshcore/guard.json).

kind.description: direct: one contact, encrypted per pair, acknowledged; channel: a group channel slot, never acknowledged

transport.description: lora-mc = MeshCore. lora-mt (Meshtastic) is reserved for 1.1 and refused here.

origin.description: hub: the radio docked on the hub (onemindd); phone-direct: imported from the phone's own radio (POST /v1/messages/import, #865)

peer.description: An opaque peer id (a direct contact); clients never parse it. null on a channel message.

channel_index.description: The radio's channel slot; null on a direct message

sender_ts.description: The sender's own clock in Unix seconds, as the frame carried it (may be wrong)

rx_at.description: When the radio handed it to OneMind (RFC 3339 UTC); null on an outgoing message

path_len.description: The encoded path length byte as received; null on an outgoing message

attempts.description: Send attempts used, every one counted against the airtime budget

state.description: Delivery state of an outgoing message; null on an incoming one

action_id.description: The approved message.send action that sent it
